pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: Introduce the Live Knowledge system, explaining its purpose as an intelligent real-time screen monitoring and knowledge extraction application, and provide a high-level overview of its architecture

pages.title: Architecture
pages.purpose: Explain the overall system architecture, including the Electron process model, key services, and how components interact

pages.title: Electron Process Model
pages.purpose: Detail the main process vs renderer process architecture, explaining the responsibilities of each and how they communicate

pages.title: IPC Communication Layer
pages.purpose: Explain the Inter-Process Communication system, including the preload script, window.api interface, and IPC channel patterns

pages.title: Core Services
pages.purpose: Overview of the main process services including MonitoringService, DatabaseService, AIEngine, PluginManager, and PresentationService

pages.title: Monitoring & Knowledge Extraction
pages.purpose: Explain how the system continuously monitors screen content, detects changes, extracts information, and generates insights using AI

pages.title: MonitoringService
pages.purpose: Deep dive into the MonitoringService, including screen watching, context capture windows, and the monitoring lifecycle

pages.title: Content Analysis Pipeline
pages.purpose: Explain how screen content is analyzed, including OCR extraction, tag generation, and context aggregation

pages.title: AI Engine Integration
pages.purpose: Detail how the AI Engine processes context, generates insights, and produces suggested actions using LLM providers

pages.title: Knowledge Management
pages.purpose: Explain how knowledge items and insights are stored, retrieved, and displayed in the KnowledgePanel UI

pages.title: Plugin System
pages.purpose: Comprehensive guide to the plugin architecture, explaining how plugins extend the system at input, core, and output phases

pages.title: Plugin SDK & Interface
pages.purpose: Document the LiveKnowledgePlugin interface, PluginContext, and the lifecycle hooks (getContext, enrichPrompt, onAction, onEvent)

pages.title: PluginManager Service
pages.purpose: Explain how the PluginManager loads, registers, and executes plugins, including installation from various package formats

pages.title: Plugin Development Guide
pages.purpose: Tutorial on creating plugins, including the DevToolsPlugin example, package structure, and integration with main and renderer processes

pages.title: Plugin UI Integration
pages.purpose: Explain how renderer-side plugins work, including the plugin registry, dynamic route loading, and UI component registration

pages.title: Plugin Management UI
pages.purpose: Document the Plugins page UI for installing, uninstalling, enabling/disabling, and configuring plugins

pages.title: User Interface
pages.purpose: Overview of the React-based renderer process UI, including the design system, layout, and major pages

pages.title: Design System
pages.purpose: Document the design tokens and reusable UI components including Button, StatusBadge, StatCard, EmptyState, and SidePanel

pages.title: Layout & Navigation
pages.purpose: Explain the Layout component, sidebar navigation, and dynamic plugin route integration

pages.title: KnowledgePanel Component
pages.purpose: Deep dive into the KnowledgePanel, including data loading, search/filter/sort, detail view, and real-time insight updates

pages.title: Settings Page
pages.purpose: Document the Settings page, focusing on AI configuration (provider, API key, model selection) and the provider cache mechanism

pages.title: SchemaForm Component
pages.purpose: Explain the dynamic form generation system that renders forms from JSON schema definitions, used in plugin configuration

pages.title: Data Models & Storage
pages.purpose: Document the core data models (KnowledgeItem, Insight, Tag, Action, etc.) and SQLite database schema

pages.title: API Reference
pages.purpose: Complete reference of all IPC channels, window.api methods, and HTTP API endpoints exposed by the APIServer

pages.title: Development Guide
pages.purpose: Guide for developers contributing to the codebase, including setup, build process, and testing
